title: Latency-Tolerant Cloud-Edge Collaborative Vision-Language-Action Models via Emergent Representational Specialization
abstract: arXiv:2608.00569v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Deploying billion-parameter Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies on mobile robots creates a systems conflict: semantic reasoning benefits from cloud GPUs, whereas closed-loop control must respond locally despite network delay and jitter. Existing hierarchical and asynchronous policies improve throughput, but their slow-path representations can still arrive stale or require explicit scheduling and delay cues. We introduce CloudEdgeVLA, a cloud-edge policy that treats temporal misalignment as a representation-learning problem. A cloud VLA encodes delayed observations into slowly varying task features, while a lightweight edge head combines the latest available cloud feature with current local vision. During training, current and randomly delayed frames are paired with the same current action target in fresh and stale paths. This objective encourages the cloud representation to preserve task-level information while the edge path

translated_title: 基于涌现表示特化的延迟容忍云边协同视觉-语言-动作模型
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.00569v2 公告类型：替换交叉 摘要：在移动机器人上部署数十亿参数的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略引发了系统冲突：语义推理受益于云GPU，而闭环控制必须在本地响应，尽管存在网络延迟和抖动。现有的分层和异步策略提高了吞吐量，但其慢路径表示可能仍然过期到达，或需要显式调度和延迟提示。我们引入了CloudEdgeVLA，一种云边策略，将时间错位视为表示学习问题。云VLA将延迟观测编码为缓慢变化的任务特征，而轻量级边缘头结合最新的可用云特征与当前局部视觉。在训练过程中，当前帧和随机延迟帧与相同的当前动作目标配对，分别通过新鲜路径和过期路径。这一目标鼓励云表示保留任务级信息，而边缘路径则专注于即时响应。
tldr: 本文提出CloudEdgeVLA，通过将时间错位转化为表示学习问题，使云VLA生成缓慢变化的任务特征，边缘头结合最新云特征与局部视觉，从而实现无需显式延迟调度即可容忍网络延迟的云边协同VLA策略。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CloudEdgeVLA, which treats temporal misalignment as a representation-learning problem, enabling cloud VLA to generate slowly varying task features and an edge head to combine the latest cloud features with local vision, achieving latency-tolerant cloud-edge VLA policies without explicit delay scheduling.
